title: Has anyone built an AI-powered electricity trading and battery storage optimization platform?
author: Expensive_Guava8970
selftext:
Hi everyone,  
I’m currently exploring a potential software development project for an energy trading company that also has its own electricity generation facilities and battery energy storage systems (BESS).  
The idea is to develop an AI-powered platform that could:  
Forecast electricity prices on day-ahead and intraday markets.  
Analyze historical prices, weather forecasts, electricity generation, demand, and market trends.  
Predict the most profitable periods to sell electricity.  
Optimize battery charging and discharging by storing electricity when prices are low and selling it when prices are higher.  
Provide trading recommendations based on expected profitability, battery capacity, efficiency, and operational constraints.  
Potentially support automated trading in later development stages.  
The main goal is not just to predict electricity prices but to **maximize trading profitability by combining price forecasting with battery storage optimization**.  
I’m particularly interested in hearing from people who have worked on similar projects.  
**A few questions:**  
Has anyone developed or worked with an AI-based electricity trading or BESS optimization platform?  
Which technologies, machine learning models, or optimization algorithms did you use?  
What data sources or APIs would you recommend for European electricity markets?  
What were the biggest technical challenges, especially regarding price forecasting accuracy and battery optimization?  
Are there any existing open-source projects, frameworks, or commercial platforms worth studying?  
We’re currently in the research and planning stage, so I’m looking to learn from real-world experiences before defining the technical architecture.  
Any insights, recommendations, or lessons learned would be greatly appreciated.  
Thanks!
